_comment: Policy rationale: grants the AgentCore Runtime the workload-identity token actions required by the Cognito JWT inbound authorizer, scoped to the default workload-identity directory. Browser-tool actions (CreateBrowser, StartBrowserSession, Connect*Stream, ...) are granted separately in browser-policy.json, and logs/metrics/traces in cloudwatch-policy.json. GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId is intentionally omitted: it issues a workload token from a caller-supplied user id without verifying a JWT, which AWS recommends against for JWT-based runtimes (see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-permissions.html).
